fact: The 2023 and 2024 Annual Schools Censuses Draft Report (EMIS, August 2024) publishes education statistics from one administrative source, the Annual School Census returns of 13,033 schools, covering the 2022/23 and 2023/24 school years in one edition.
title: 2023 and 2024 Annual Schools Censuses Draft Report
publisher: Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education, EMIS
